name: Klettersteig am Kitzbüheler Horn
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Klettersteig at **Kitzbüheler Horn** offers breathtaking views and secure climbing fun for beginners and intermediate climbers. Along well-secured steel ropes, you’ll conquer rocky sections while enjoying stunning panoramas of the **Kitzbüheler Alps** time and again. The **Hornbahn** mountain station serves as a convenient starting point.
